subject: Medisun: payment-rail sweep + intercompany VAT routing request
messages:
From: Amparo Ruiz <amparo.ruiz@medisun.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medisun Finance <finance@medisun.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary net60 + VAT routing for EU subsidiaries

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — I'm reaching out from Medisun's treasury team. We're in the middle of a platform consolidation across our EU entities and need a temporary adjustment to our payment rails to align with the accounts-payable cutover. Specifically: could Redwood consider a temporary Net60 for invoices dated through the end of Q4 (we expect remits to normalize in Jan)?

Two practical asks:
- Route invoices and VAT handling to our Ireland entity (Medisun Ireland Ltd.) for this period (we'll provide the VAT reg. doc).
- Provide an interim AR schedule and confirmation of the invoice cadence so we can plan our cash waterfall.

I've attached the AR aging export for context (Medisun-AR-aging-2026Q3.xlsx). If possible, we'd like a short amendment to our contract to reflect Net60 and the VAT routing. We're open to a staged repayment or deposit if Redwood would prefer.

Do you have 30 minutes early next week to discuss?

Best,
Amparo Ruiz
Head of Treasury, Medisun Health
finance@medisun.com

Attachment: Medisun-AR-aging-2026Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amparo Ruiz <amparo.ruiz@medisun.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary net60 + VAT routing for EU subsidiaries

Amparo — thanks for the context and the AR export, that helps. We can be flexible but want to balance cash exposure and tax correctness. Proposal from our side:

- Pilot Net45 on outstanding invoices through 2026-12-31 (compromise vs Net60).
- Require a 25% deposit on new invoices > $50k while the Net45 pilot is in effect.
- Route VAT to Medisun Ireland Ltd. once you provide the VAT registration certificate and confirm billing entity mapping (we'll need to update tax metadata in our billing system).

Operational asks for us to proceed:
1) Signed amendment (we can draft) that sets the temporary Net45 and deposit terms;
2) VAT reg. cert for Medisun Ireland Ltd.;
3) Confirmation of expected monthly invoice run rate so we can set a $ credit cap (we typically cap interim exposure).

If agreeable, I'll draft the amendment and loop legal + finance. Can you do a quick call Tuesday 10/3 or Wednesday 10/4 morning PT?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: temporary net60 + VAT routing for EU subsidiaries

Olga — thanks for the quick turnaround and the constructive compromise.

We can provide the VAT certificate and confirm the invoice cadence by end of day Monday. Regarding the deposit: Medisun can accept a 25% deposit for invoices > $50k for the pilot window. Also, as an operational trade-off, would Redwood consider an early-pay incentive? E.g., 1.5% discount if we pay within 10 days.

I'll review your draft amendment when you send it. We'll also route our procurement head to sign the DocuSign if everything looks standard.

FWIW — forwarding your draft to finance internally for a preliminary sign-off.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Medisun: payment-rail sweep + intercompany VAT routing request

Looping in quick internal guidance: finance is comfortable running a controlled pilot for Q4 under these constraints. Approvals:

- Credit exposure cap: $250,000 until January 15, 2027.
- Net45 pilot window: invoices issued 2026-10-29 through 2026-12-31.
- 25% deposit required on invoices > $50k.
- Early-pay discount: allowed (we approve 1.5% if paid within 10 days).

Please ensure the amendment includes a clause that automatically reverts to standard Net30 if VAT routing or registration docs are not received within 10 business days of amendment execution. Finance will flag any invoices exceeding the cap for manual review — please route those to ar-ops@redwood.ai.

Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
